summary: Frontend-only test for two UI changes: (1) SinaisTab single idle card + combined scoreboard vs triggered strategy cards; (2) RadarTab ESTRATÉGIA FB GREEN/RED scoreboard. All 5 scenarios PASSED in one browser session.
critical_code_review_comments: RadarTab.jsx is ~750 lines (>700 threshold) — consider splitting into subcomponents (History, Regions, Ocultos, FB, Juncao) for maintainability.
SinaisTab.jsx renders SignalsArea/StrategyCard as functions defined inside parent render — could cause unnecessary re-mounts; consider hoisting or using React.memo (minor perf, no functional issue).

gatilho-scoreboard-total sums scores across ALL strategies including inactive/deleted ones (scores keyed by strategyId persist in sessionStorage even after strategy delete). Consider filtering by activeStrategies IDs when computing totalScore.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 strategies via Admin UI: 'Strat A' (trigger 5,10 → entry 2,8) and 'Strat B' (trigger 1,3 → entry 20,25). Stored in localStorage 'sinais_strategies'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified in one session: (1) With no giros → single card [data-testid=gatilho-idle] with combined [data-testid=gatilho-scoreboard-total] shows GREEN:0 RED:0, no per-strategy cards. (2) After entering 5,10 → only signal-active-{stratA_id} visible; Strat B not rendered as idle card; main idle hidden. (3) After entering 1,3 → both signal-active-{A} and signal-active-{B} visible simultaneously. (4) Radar tab fb-card contains fb-scoreboard showing GREEN:0 RED:0 at bottom. Screenshots at .screenshots/sinais_idle.png, sinais_A_triggered.png, sinais_both_triggered.png, radar_fb.png.
